record.paper_title: Open problems on structure of positively curved projective varieties
record.context_brief: Yau conjecture on positive holomorphic sectional curvature
record.original_question: If X is a compact Kähler manifold with positive holomorphic sectional curvature, must X be projective and rationally connected?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 3.1 (Yau’s conjecture, [54, Problem 47]). — If a compact Kähler manifold X has positive holomorphic sectional curvature, then X is projective and rationally connected.
Yang in [51] solved Yau’s conjecture by introducing the notion of the RC positivity

artifact.self_contained_problem: Let $X$ be a compact Kähler manifold of complex dimension $n$, equipped with a Kähler metric $\omega$ whose holomorphic sectional curvature is everywhere strictly positive; that is, for every point $x \in X$ and every nonzero holomorphic tangent vector $v \in T_x X$, the sectional curvature $H(v) = R(v,\bar v, v, \bar v)/|v|^4$ is positive. Prove or disprove the following statement: under these hypotheses, $X$ is necessarily a projective algebraic variety, and moreover $X$ is rationally connected, meaning that any two points of $X$ can be joined by a chain of rational curves (equivalently, there exists an irreducible rational curve through any two general points of $X$).
artifact.category_tag: Kähler manifolds and holomorphic sectional curvature
artifact.status_search_result: Xiaokui Yang (2017, arXiv:1708.06713; published in Peking Mathematical Journal / related venues) introduced the notion of RC-positivity and used it to prove that a compact Kähler manifold with positive holomorphic sectional curvature is projective and rationally connected, thereby resolving Yau's conjecture.

status_evidence.title: RC-positivity, rational connectedness and Yau's conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Yang shows that a compact Kähler manifold with positive holomorphic sectional curvature is projective and rationally connected, confirming Yau's conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture has been solved by Xiaokui Yang using RC-positivity.
